Weeks after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] launched an adventure to '''hunt''' the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

==Prelude==
The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], captain of the [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] along with his friend and co-pilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] earned a price on their heads after failing to deliver a load for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. They also earned a bounty from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after taking part in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SW Missions 5" />

==The hunt==
===Hunt on Tatooine===
Solo, with his friends known as the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]], were on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] a few weeks later. They encountered a group of [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] who had captured the young Hutt [[Grubba Desilijic Aarrpo]]. They rescued Grubba and made arrangements to return him to his uncle Jabba.<ref name="SW Missions 5" />

Along the way, they were hunted by a group of bounty hunters&mdash;[[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], [[Udin]], and [[Eron Stonefield]]. Once they heard that the ''Millennium Falcon'' was about to land and meet with Jabba's agents, one of them set off on a [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] in the middle of a sandstorm. The hunter infiltrated the ''Falcon'' and made off with Grubba. Skywalker then used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] and the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards to let them escape.<ref name="SW Missions 5" />

===Showdown on Kubindi===
Desperate to re-locate the Hutt, the Heroes of Yavin interrogated a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]]. He revealed that the hunters were likely going to Udin's tribe&mdash;the [[Zabin Hive]] on [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]]. They were then chased out of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] by the [[Tatooine militia]].<ref name="SW Missions 6" />

Once on Kubindi, they faced a tough journey through the forest and being captured by the hive, before one of them negotiated with [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Zabin]] for their freedom. By that time, though, the hunters had escaped again with Grubba, seeking refuge with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Olan Dewes]].<ref name="SW Missions 6" />

===Liberation of Ithor===
{{Main|Battle of Ithor (0 ABY)}}
A short while later, the Heroes of Yavin agreed to join with exiled leader [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] and escort him to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. The crew posed as Torturer [[Vengnar Heiff]], and faked a crash landing. They then took Nadon to the ''[[Tafanda Bay]]'', where he inspired an [[Battle of Ithor (0 ABY)|uprising]] of the Ithorians. Both General Dewes and Torturer Heiff were captured, and the fleet sent by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] helped drive off the Imperial blockade.<ref name="SW Missions 7" />

Solo and his crew also re-rescued Grubba. They made arrangements with Jabba to meet with his agents on [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]] and claim the reward. Unbeknownst to them, Jabba sent notice of the rendezvous to the bounty hunters as well so they could capture the smuggler.<ref name="SW Missions 7" />

===Allying with the Togorians===
Princess Organa used her diplomatic connections to land in the city of [[Caross]] on Togoria.<ref name="SW Missions 8" />

Before they landed, they were ambushed by the hunters. Solo hit the [[Punishing One/Legends|''Punishing One'']] with an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]], causing it to crash into the jungle, although they made it to an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].<ref name="SW Missions 8" />

The hunters discovered the [[Mindnight Fire clan]], and they convinced the clan to aid in their adventure to find Solo, by deceiving them that Solo had captured Grubba himself.<ref name="SW Missions 8" />

The clan ambushed the Heroes of Yavin in Caross, with one sneaking aboard the ''Falcon''. Solo got into a Corellian standoff with the hunter, but after Grubba betrayed them, they were captured.<ref name="SW Missions 8" />

The hunters sent a signal to the Empire to collect the bounty on the Heroes of Yavin, but the Togorians intercepted the signal, allowing the Alliance to send the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Valiant (Victory-class)|''Valiant'']] with [[Fordwyn]] acting as an Imperial captain. Fordwyn paid off the hunters with forged [[Credit chip/Legends|credit disks]], allowing them to leave with the Hutt.<ref name="SW Missions 8" />

==Aftermath==
Jabba the Hutt told the hunters how they had been tricked and had them return Grubba, who had [[Sabacc/Legends|gambled]] 85% of his bounty. The Heroes of Yavin went on to other missions.<ref name="SW Missions 8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The hunt appears across several books in the ''[[Star Wars Missions]]'' series by [[Scholastic]]
